title: Flex Token Lifecycle
goal: Move from a Flex Microform transient token to a correctly scoped permanent TMS instrument without treating the JWT as a reusable PAN.
prompt:
Workflow: Flex Token Lifecycle
Goal: Move from a Flex Microform transient token to a correctly scoped permanent TMS instrument without treating the JWT as a reusable PAN.

Using only the allowed context, produce a step-by-step integration plan that covers every workflow stage. Do not call live payment APIs. Do not include credentials, PANs, or secrets.
allowed_context: Flex Microform returns a short-lived transientTokenJwt
TMS createInstrument accepts a Flex token via a dedicated transient-token path, not as raw pan
Transient tokens must not be persisted as long-lived customer credentials
constraints: No raw PAN, secrets, or credential logging
Public forum/docs seeds are frozen input only
expected_deliverable: A structured plan listing each stage, the API/SDK fact it depends on, and the readiness check before moving to the next stage.
